name: Fig Tree Residences

Consistent with the developer's Google-map screenshot (site just south of Fig Tree Bay, 150 m from King Jason Hotel) and with OSM: Capo Bay Hotel is ~0.4 km away (developer: 350 m). KNX smart-home automation (lighting, shading, HVAC, blinds)
Videophone entry, CCTV and fire detection in common areas
facts: Fig Tree Residences is an off-plan apartment scheme in Protaras, Famagusta district, about 250 m from the Blue Flag Fig Tree Bay beach.
The scheme has two apartment buildings (Block A and Block B) around a communal swimming pool, plus two detached villas with private pools.

Block B, where the apartments for sale are, has parking and storage on the ground floor, three two-bedroom apartments on each of the first and second floors and two three-bedroom apartments on the top floor.
The two-bedroom apartments have two bathrooms, about 78 m² of internal space and a covered veranda of about 21 m².

Every apartment has an A-class Energy Performance Certificate; external walls are 250 mm thermal clay brick with an external thermal insulation system, and windows are thermal aluminium frames with double glazing.
Each apartment comes with a KNX smart-automation system controlling lighting, blinds, hot water and a VRF air-conditioning system, plus sound-system provision in the living room and bedrooms.

Kitchens and vanities have large-format porcelain-slab worktops and soft-close cupboards; bathrooms use imported sanitary ware with walk-in showers and channel drains, with a choice of three finish palettes.
Common areas have CCTV, fire detection, videophone entry, landscaped planting and a photovoltaic system; each parking space has an EV-charging provision.
The developer states distances of 250 m to Fig Tree Bay beach, 50 m to a supermarket, 100 m to restaurants and shops, 1.2 km to a private hospital and 45 km to Larnaca Airport.

conflicts: Scheme composition / unit count: the website says '10 units, Apartments & Villas, 2 & 3 bedrooms, 80-120 m²' and its availability table lists Block B (B101-B103, B201-B203, B301-B302) plus Villa H1 and H2 (4-bed, 185-192 m² buildable, both RESERVED). That 10 excludes Block A, which the Block A 'investors' presentation shows as a separate 3-floor building with 4 apartments per floor (12 apartments counted from plans, not stated in text) on adjoining plots 335/336 with the communal pool. Block B + villas sit on plot 337. totalUnitsInScheme left null.
Website headline '2 & 3 bedrooms, 80-120 m²' contradicts its own table (villas are 4-bed, 185-192 m²; Block B 3-beds 138-149 m² buildable).
Protaras Centre is 800 m on the presentation's distances page but 400 m on the presentation's aerial location image.
Presentation distances page says 'Larnaca Marina 3.7 km', which is clearly wrong (probably Paralimni Marina).
Block A investors deck mentions a gym; no other document (specs, Block B deck, website) does, so it was not used.
No interior images exist in the share (no '2. interior' folder); the gallery is exteriors/aerials only. One render (PICTURE (5)) carries a large developer logo on the façade and was excluded.
